Comprehensive Management System Solutions

From initial gap analysis to certification and beyond, we provide end-to-end support for your management system journey.

ISO Certification

Expert guidance for ISO 9001, 14001, 45001, 27001 & other international standards. Full implementation support.

​Gap Analysis & Auditing

Thorough assessments to identify compliance gaps and prepare your organization for successful certification.

DISP Compliance

Defense Industry Security Program consulting and compliance services for defense contractors and suppliers.

Documentation Services

Professional development of manuals, procedures, work instructions, and forms aligned with standard requirements.

Training Academy

Comprehensive training programs, workshops, and courses for internal auditors, lead auditors, and management representatives.

Management Systems Integration

Integrate multiple management systems (QMS, EMS, OHSMS) for streamlined operations and reduced duplication.

Learn More

Tailored Management System Solutions

Choose from our specialised solutions designed to meet your specific industry and compliance requirements.

DISP

ISO Services

We guide organisations through every stage of their compliance journey. From understanding the benefits of ISO certification to identifying system gaps, conducting internal audits, and ensuring ongoing compliance through monitoring and maintenance, we provide practical and strategic support to help businesses grow with confidence and integrity.

Meet The Team

​At integPRO, our strength lies in our people. We're a diverse team of passionate consultants, auditors, and specialists who bring deep industry knowledge and a shared commitment to helping businesses thrive.

With a collaborative spirit and a focus on real results, we’re here to guide you every step of the way.

sections.text:
Your Trusted Partner in ISO & DISP

Since 1998, IntegPro has been Australia’s leading provider of management system consulting, training, and certification services. Our mission is to help organizations achieve and maintain excellence through internationally recognized standards.
 

With a team of highly qualified consultants, lead auditors, and trainers, we’ve successfully guided over 1,000 organizations through ISO certification, DISP compliance, and integrated management system implementation.

Learn More
50 +

Combined Years of Experience

122 +

Successful Clients

What Our Client Say

Trusted by organisations across Australia for management system excellence.

"The team at IntegPro have been incredibly helpful in managing our DISP requirements. As a small business, it can be challenging to stay on top of every obligation while juggling multiple roles, and their support has made a huge difference."

Demmi Wright

OS of DISP

"From our first call to the Stage 2 audit, Maria and Mehrdad at IntegPro were outstanding. They combined deep expertise with practical guidance, were responsive and calm, and worked alongside our team to embed an Integrated Management System"

Andrew Richards

Security Director

"We engaged IntegPRO to help us achieve ISO certification for Safety (ISO 45001), Environment (ISO 14001), and Quality (ISO 9001) management systems. Right from the start, their team showed a practical understanding of our specialised."

Jayesh

Operations Director

Start Your Certification Journey

Contact us today for a free consultation and gap analysis. Let’s discuss how we can help you achieve certification excellence.
